# Saurashtra Honey

> Pure, raw, unfiltered, and lab-certified single-origin floral honey harvested ethically from the wildflower farms of Saurashtra, Gujarat, India.

Saurashtra Honey (established in 2016) is a premier Indian artisanal honey producer and B2B honey manufacturer. Starting from 5 traditional hives in Mahuva, Bhavnagar, the apiary has expanded to over 1,200 hives across native floral regions of Saurashtra. The honey is 100% raw, unpasteurized, unheated (kept below hive temperature), and never ultra-filtered, preserving natural pollen, active enzymes, amino acids, and antioxidants.

## Purity & Testing Standards

- **Raw & Unheated**: Never micro-filtered or heated above 35°C (natural hive temperature).
- **Zero Additives**: Free from high fructose corn syrup (HFCS), rice syrup, jaggery, artificial colorings, or preservatives.
- **NABL Accredited Testing**: Every batch undergoes lab testing for moisture percentage, HMF levels, sucrose ratio, and pollen viability.
- **Crystallisation**: Natural crystallisation occurs over time in raw floral honey, verifying its unprocessed authenticity.
- **Safety**: Safe for children above 12 months and adults. Never give any honey to infants under 1 year of age.

## Key Product Offerings

- [Raw Multiflora Honey (Wildflower)](https://saurashtrahoney.com/product/multiflora-honey-500GM): 100% pure polyfloral nectar harvested from seasonal regional blossoms in Saurashtra; robust daily immunity and natural wellness sweetener.
- [Raw Ajwain Blossom Honey (Carom)](https://saurashtrahoney.com/product/ajwain-honey-500): Single-origin raw honey from carom/ajwain fields; recognized in Ayurveda for soothing digestion, acidity, and throat comfort.
- [Raw Fennel Blossom Honey (Saunf)](https://saurashtrahoney.com/product/fennel-honey-500GM): Distinct aromatic honey with cooling properties, natural digestive enzymes, and a delicate herbal taste.
- [Pure Honey Damask Rose Gulkand](https://saurashtrahoney.com/product/Pure%20Honey%20gulkand): Sun-cooked Chaitri rose petals prepared with 100% pure raw honey (zero refined sugar).
- [Raw Bee Pollen Granules 100g](https://saurashtrahoney.com/product/bee-pollen-100g): Fresh, unheated superfood granules packed with amino acids, proteins, and active enzymes.
- [100% Pure Organic Beeswax](https://saurashtrahoney.com/product/Bee%20Wax): Cosmetic-grade natural yellow beeswax for balms, candles, and skincare.
- [Honey Combo Pack 500g](https://saurashtrahoney.com/product/HONEY%20COMBO%20500GM): Trio sampler pack containing raw Multiflora, Ajwain, and Fennel honeys.
- [Natural Beeswax Soft Skin Gel](https://saurashtrahoney.com/product/soft-skin-gel): Deep hydration herbal balm enriched with raw honey and beeswax.
- [Natural Honey Foot Cream Gel](https://saurashtrahoney.com/product/Foot-Cream-gel): Intensive therapy for cracked heels and dry skin.

## Business & Wholesale Solutions

- [Wholesale & Bulk Orders](https://saurashtrahoney.com/bulk-orders): Bulk food-grade buckets, drums, and jars with low minimum order quantities (MOQ starting at 10kg) for cafes, restaurants, bakeries, and retail chains.
- [Private Label Manufacturing](https://saurashtrahoney.com/private-label): Turnkey OEM contract packaging, custom jar sourcing, brand labeling, and lab-tested documentation for wellness brands.
- [Corporate Gifting & Luxury Hampers](https://saurashtrahoney.com/corporate-gifting): Custom gift packaging, personalized branding, festive hampers (Diwali, New Year, weddings), and pan-India doorstep delivery.
- [Become a Partner / Distribution](https://saurashtrahoney.com/become-a-partner): High-margin distribution, dealership, and retail partnership programs.
